_README.title: US Major Market Indices - Daily Snapshot
_README.description: Core US equity indices representing the broad market, large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap segments
_README.purpose: Track overall US market performance across different market capitalizations
_README.update_frequency: Daily after market close (4:00 PM ET)

indices_included.^DJI: Dow Jones Industrial Average - Blue-chip 30 companies
indices_included.^VIX: CBOE Volatility Index - Market fear gauge (VIX)

metrics_explained.52_week_high: Highest price in past 252 trading days
metrics_explained.52_week_low: Lowest price in past 252 trading days
metrics_explained.year_to_date_return: Return from Jan 1 to current date
metrics_explained.pivot_points: Support/Resistance levels calculated from previous day's High, Low, Close using formula: PP=(H+L+C)/3, R1=(2×PP)-L, S1=(2×PP)-H

pivot_points_usage.description: Classic pivot points for intraday support and resistance
pivot_points_usage.calculation: Based on previous trading day's High, Low, and Close
pivot_points_usage.resistance_levels: R1, R2, R3 - Price levels where selling pressure may emerge
pivot_points_usage.support_levels: S1, S2, S3 - Price levels where buying interest may appear
pivot_points_usage.trading_application: Price above PP = bullish bias, below PP = bearish bias

interpretation.market_health: If S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq all positive = broad market strength
interpretation.breadth_signal: All 6 indices green = strong breadth, mixed = rotation
